ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 40% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and trailing regions and 60% high-intensity (white) pixels on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a contiguous low-intensity (black) anchor-shaped blob. Lateral regions display high-intensity (white) zones with significant pixel-level mottling and dark speckling particularly near the interior boundaries and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence; calculated angle approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely jagged trailing edge topography with high-frequency variations; pixel-amplitude spikes of varying depths are visible across the entire length from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward concave curvature originating from the median notch and extending toward the lateral fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular pixel clusters detected: approximately 15 white rings on the central black surface and 10 dark circular marks on the distal white surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several fine, dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the high-intensity white background of the left distal lobe and a single prominent diagonal stroke on the right lobe near the tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosette patterns) across the ventral surface; distinct irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately 70% distal from center.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique high-contrast 'salt and pepper' pixel transition zone between the solid black central region and the white lateral lobes.
